original: Available evidence does not list fuel stations within the AONB boundary. Travelers should refuel in nearby gateway towns like Newry before heading into the forest park.
translated: Verfügbare Beweise führen keine Tankstellen innerhalb der AONB-Grenze auf. Reisende sollten in nahe gelegenen Torstädten wie Newry tanken, bevor sie in den Waldpark gehen.
method: Argos en-de offline; language-quality review not certified
